lookup_clip_ids_for_subset: look up the CMU mocap clip IDs for a named subset like walk_tiny or run_jump_tiny
list_available_subsets: list all available CMU mocap subset names from CMU_SUBSETS_DICT
get_clip_collection: get a ClipCollection object containing clip IDs for a specific locomotion behavior subset
filter_clips_by_subject: filter clip IDs from a subset by CMU subject number such as CMU_016 or CMU_069
count_clips_in_subset: count the total number of clip IDs in a given CMU mocap subset collection
